pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Holding Her Shotgun Beside a Cactus in the Desert Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Brawl Stars Shelly holding her shotgun beside a cactus in a desert arena, with a bandanna and tall boots. Her cheek bandage, belt pouch, and broad ponytail add smaller sections to the coloring sheet, while a crate, a barrel, and stepped rock walls frame her standing pose.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Bandita Shelly Beside a Wanted Poster Outside a Wild West Saloon Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandita Shelly stands beside her wanted poster outside a Wild West saloon in this printable coloring page, wearing an eye patch and holding her shotgun. The coloring sheet includes spurred boots, a neck bandanna, swinging saloon doors, and a hanging lantern, with narrow wood-plank details surrounding the larger character outlines.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Star Shelly Showing Her Star Decorated Shotgun in Her Original Exclusive Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Brawl Stars Star Shelly displaying her star-decorated shotgun, with matching stars on her ponytail accessory, shoulder, belt buckle, and boots. A cactus and stacked crates fill the desert backdrop. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing and hair sections with smaller outlined emblems and gun details.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Witch Shelly Balancing Her Cat on Her Pointed Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Witch Shelly balances a cat on her pointed hat in this printable coloring page, holding her shotgun while lifting the wide brim with one hand. Skull decorations appear on her hatband and belt, and striped stockings extend above her boots. The coloring sheet sets these costume details against sparse desert crates and rocks.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Psg Shelly Kicking a Football Into the Brawl Ball Goal Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows PSG Shelly kicking a football toward the Brawl Ball goal, wearing a striped jersey, matching shorts, long socks, and cleats. Her forward boot and the large ball dominate the coloring sheet, with smaller kit emblems, net squares, and skull-star flags adding detail behind the action.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Princess Shelly Holding Her Frog-shaped Shotgun at a Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Shelly holds her frog-shaped shotgun at a castle gate in this printable coloring page, wearing a jeweled crown, puffed sleeves, and a layered dress. Crown banners hang beside the arched entrance. The coloring sheet offers broad skirt panels and stone blocks alongside smaller gems, wrist decorations, and the frog gun's large eyes.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Classic Shelly Testing Her Old Fashioned Shotgun at a Wooden Shooting Range Target Coloring Page
pages.description: Classic Shelly tests her old-fashioned shotgun at a wooden shooting-range target in this printable coloring page, standing with bent arms and a wide-legged stance. Concentric target rings and scattered impact marks provide distinct areas on the coloring sheet, alongside her ammunition belt, tall boots, nearby crates, and the fence behind her.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Hoot Hoot Shelly Riding Her Owl Themed Broom Above a Brawl-o-Ween Graveyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hoot Hoot Shelly riding her owl-themed broom above a Brawl-o-ween graveyard, with an owl ornament across her pointed hat. Feather-shaped costume edges echo the broom's tail. Bats, a cratered moon, skull-marked tombstones, and an iron gate create numerous smaller background sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Dancer Performing a Dance Beneath a Sands of Time Palace Archway Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly Dancer performs beneath a Sands of Time palace archway in this printable coloring page, raising one hand above her head while extending the other. Her jeweled headband, hoop earrings, and draped sleeves stand out on the coloring sheet, with patterned columns, urns, palms, and distant domed towers completing the scene.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Squad Buster Shelly Leading a Charge Across a Wooden Arena Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Squad Buster Shelly leads a charge across a wooden arena bridge in this printable coloring page, with her star-marked gun raised and one boot forward. Two teammates run behind her between the rope rails. The coloring sheet features repeated star decorations on her outfit, broad bridge planks, and stepped canyon walls beyond.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Cyber Shelly Advancing Through a Futuristic Nanonoodles City Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Cyber Shelly advances through a futuristic Nanonoodles city street in this printable coloring page, carrying an angular shotgun and wearing segmented armor with pointed headphones. Large noodle-bowl signs and hanging lanterns mark the surrounding buildings. The coloring sheet combines broad armor panels with smaller weapon vents, window frames, and layered street architecture.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Sheriff Shelly Escorting Her Team's Minecart Along the Payload Track Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sheriff Shelly escorting her team's minecart along the Payload track, wearing a star-badged cowboy hat and holding her gun upright. Faceted crystals fill the wooden cart beside her. Curving rails, wheel rims, star-decorated boots, and a timber mine entrance add varied enclosed details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Stellar Shelly Lifting a Trophy on the Victory Podium Coloring Page
pages.description: Stellar Shelly lifts a star-emblem trophy on the victory podium in this printable coloring page, wearing angular armor, a jeweled headpiece, and a flowing cape. Confetti and four-point sparkles surround her raised arm. Large podium faces provide open coloring areas, while the costume gems and trophy wings add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Firing a Wide Buckshot Spread at the Training Cave Robot Targets Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly firing a wide buckshot spread at Training Cave robot targets, with a jagged muzzle flash and round pellets overhead. Three robots stand on platforms among the rock walls and timber supports. The coloring sheet separates her broad outfit shapes from the smaller target rings, crate braces, and weapon details.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Using Super Shell to Blast a Passage Through a Block Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly uses Super Shell to blast a passage through a block wall in this printable coloring page, bracing her shotgun as angular debris flies outward. A large muzzle flash marks the broken opening beside her. The coloring sheet includes broad stone faces, small scattered rubble, belt ammunition, and the star emblem on her weapon.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Using Fast Forward to Dash Away From Colt's Incoming Bullets Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly using Fast Forward to dash away from Colt's incoming bullets, with her shotgun held close and her boots lifted. Colt fires two pistols from behind a distant crate. Curved speed lines and dust emphasize Shelly's diagonal movement across the coloring sheet, framed by bushes and blocky arena walls.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Using Clay Pigeons to Hit a Distant Target Across a Water Channel Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly uses Clay Pigeons to aim toward a distant target across a water channel in this printable coloring page, standing on the rocky near bank. A flying disc arcs above her raised shotgun, while a circular target rests on a wooden tower. Wavy water lines and broad cliff faces leave open sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Using Super Shell to Knock Bull Backward and Slow Him with Shell Shock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly using Super Shell to knock Bull backward, with Shell Shock represented by stars and spirals around his raised head. The impact burst separates the two characters against a sparse desert horizon. Bull's open jacket, skull belt buckle, and lifted boot add distinct details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Activating Double Barrel Hypercharge Surrounded By Crackling Energy Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly activates Double Barrel Hypercharge in this printable coloring page, aiming her shotgun forward as crackling ribbons of energy wrap around the barrel and her stance. Angular sparks fill the spaces beside her ponytail, arms, and legs. The coloring sheet pairs these narrow effects with broad clothing sections, a cactus, and simple arena crates.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Breaking a Power-cube Crate in Solo Showdown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly breaking a power-cube crate in Solo Showdown, with her shotgun angled downward as splintered wooden boards fly around it. A lightning-bolt cube rises from the shattered box. The coloring sheet emphasizes the large cube, broken planks, and Shelly's forward-leaning pose against bushes, cacti, and stepped desert rocks.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Escaping the Closing Showdown Poison Clouds Through a Narrow Rock Passage Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly escapes closing Showdown poison clouds through a narrow rock passage in this printable coloring page, running forward with her shotgun held across her body. Rounded clouds crowd the gap behind her, contrasting with the angular canyon walls. The coloring sheet includes broad ponytail sections, boot panels, scattered stones, and thin cracks in the rocks.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Guarding Nita as Her Teammate Respawns Inside a Protective Bubble in Duo Showdown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly guarding Nita during a Duo Showdown respawn, with Nita standing inside a protective bubble behind Shelly's wide defensive stance. Nita's bear hood has rounded ears and a stitched patch. Crates, bushes, a barrel, and blocky stone barriers surround the two figures, adding smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Collecting a Gem as It Rises From the Central Gem Grab Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly reaches for a gem rising from the central Gem Grab mine in this printable coloring page, extending one hand while lowering her shotgun beside her. The large floating gem has broad faceted panels and radiating lines. Timber rails, a ring of crystals, and nearby crates provide additional angular shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Defending the Brawl Ball Goal as El Primo Kicks the Football Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly defending the Brawl Ball goal as El Primo kicks the football toward her, with the net stretching behind her stance. El Primo's mask and the ball's stitched panels add enclosed details. The coloring sheet keeps the two characters and incoming shot prominent against a lightly outlined field.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Blasting the Enemy Team's Safe in Heist Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly blasts the enemy team's safe in Heist in this printable coloring page, firing toward a skull-emblem door as impact bursts and fragments scatter nearby. Her wide stance faces the large safe in the foreground. The coloring sheet includes cylindrical projectiles, a barrel, crossed crate panels, and open stretches of arena ground.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Reaching for the Central Blue Star in Bounty Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly reaching for the central Bounty star, leaping with one hand extended while holding her shotgun downward in the other. The large floating star contains a smaller star and faceted ornaments. Simple cactus, crate, and hay-bale outlines keep the focus on her upward movement across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Defending a Hot Zone Capture Circle Beside Jessie's Turret Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly defends a Hot Zone capture circle beside Jessie's turret in this printable coloring page, aiming her shotgun outward from a broad, planted standing pose. The squat turret has a large barrel and an X-shaped side detail. Concentric ground rings, nearby crates, and a wooden barrel add geometric sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Facing Piper Across the Last Patch of Clear Ground in Knockout Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly facing Piper across the last clear ground in Knockout, with both brawlers aiming their weapons between surrounding clouds and barriers. Piper wears a layered dress and a flower in her hair, while Shelly stands with her back partly turned. Their contrasting silhouettes and scattered crates structure the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Shooting a Basketball Toward the Moving Hoop in Basket Brawl Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly shoots a basketball toward the moving Basket Brawl hoop in this printable coloring page, jumping with both hands around the ball and one knee raised. Motion marks follow the hoop's wheeled mounting. The coloring sheet includes a diamond-pattern net, curved court lines, and skull-star emblems on the surrounding arena boards.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Returning the Volleyball Over the Net in Volley Brawl Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly returning a volleyball over the Volley Brawl net, with her hands clasped together and her legs braced across the court. The large ball's curved panels contrast with the square net openings. Palm trees, a striped net post, and a skull-star arena emblem complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Defending Her Team's Safe From Approaching Robots in Robo Rumble Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly defends her team's safe from approaching Robo Rumble robots in this printable coloring page, standing in front of its skull-marked door with her shotgun raised. Robots crowd both sides and the foreground, showing round eye panels and pincer hands. The coloring sheet contrasts their curved mechanical shapes with Shelly's clothing and the rectangular safe.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Dodging the Giant Robot Boss's Rockets in Boss Fight Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly dodging the giant robot boss's rockets in Boss Fight, leaning into a sideways run as dust rises around her boots. The robot towers above her with spiked shoulders and circular launchers. Rocket fins, smoke trails, arena crates, and Shelly's trailing bandanna add directional details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly as the Giant Boss Surrounded By the Smaller Hunters in Big Game Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly appears as the giant boss surrounded by smaller Big Game hunters in this printable coloring page, raising her shotgun while towering above their attacks. Five small figures occupy the foreground and sides, including a bear-hooded fighter and two robots. Impact bursts, scattered fragments, and dust clouds connect the action across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Entering a Trophy Escape Exit Zone with Her Collected Trophies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Shelly entering a Trophy Escape exit zone with three collected trophies in her arms, beneath a large trophy-shaped gate emblem. Each cup carries a skull symbol, and her shotgun rests behind her shoulder. The coloring sheet includes an outlined ground circle, thick arch sections, bushes, and a distant cactus.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Carrying a Battery Toward Meg's Mecha While Enemies Approach in Mecha Guard Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly carries a large battery toward Meg's mecha as enemies approach in this printable coloring page, running with the lightning-emblem cylinder held across her chest. Meg reaches from the open cockpit while three enemy robots advance behind them. The coloring sheet includes rounded machine joints, battery bands, angular ground panels, and scattered arena rocks.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Collecting Noodle Ingredients from a Delivery Robot in Combat Cooking Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly collecting noodle ingredients from a delivery robot in Combat Cooking, lifting a bundle of noodles from its open storage compartment. Vegetables and utensils fill the wheeled robot, which has a smiling screen. Shelly's apron, chef-skull headband, noodle-shop banner, and hanging lantern provide additional details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Adding Ingredients to Her Team's Wok While Opponents Approach in Food Fight Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly adds ingredients to her team's wok while opponents approach in this printable coloring page, tipping a box of vegetables and holding a long slotted spatula. Flames rise beneath the large pan, while two brawlers run through the background. Vegetable slices, leafy tops, food crates, and triangular bunting create smaller details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Revealing an Opponent Disguised as a Barrel in Hide and Seek Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly revealing a barrel-disguised opponent in Hide and Seek, lifting the round lid while holding her shotgun upright in one hand. The masked opponent grips the rim with both hands and looks upward. Barrel staves, metal hoops, nearby crate braces, and bushes add clear divisions to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Recovering Inside a Circle of Healing Mushrooms Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly recovers inside a circle of healing mushrooms in this printable coloring page, sitting with closed eyes while her shotgun rests on the ground beside her. Spotted mushroom caps surround the ring, and plus signs, bubbles, and sparkles float overhead. The uncluttered coloring sheet combines broad outfit sections with small repeated symbols.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Running Past a Fresh Crater as Meteors Fall During Meteor Shower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly running past a fresh crater during Meteor Shower, carrying her shotgun as flaming meteors fall diagonally through the sky. Loose rocks rise beside the crater, and dust follows her boots. The coloring sheet includes round meteor pits, jagged flame trails, broad canyon walls, and a small distant cactus.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Launched From a Jump Pad Over a River in a Showdown Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly launches from a jump pad over a river in this printable coloring page, with one knee tucked upward and her shotgun extended toward the far bank. A large arrow marks the pad below her. Broad cliff faces, wavy water, distant bushes, and a single crate leave spacious background areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Emerging From a Teleporter Behind an Enemy Barricade Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly emerging from a teleporter behind an enemy barricade, stepping forward with her shotgun across her body and one boot raised. Circular machine rings frame the vertical teleport effect, with small floating rectangles around her. Cross-braced boards, a barrel, and a foreground crate add angular sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Stepping Off the Tracks as a Minecart Passes in Minecart Madness Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly steps off the tracks as a minecart passes in Minecart Madness in this printable coloring page, lifting one knee and holding her shotgun upright. Faceted crystals fill the cart beside her, with small stones bouncing near its wheels. The coloring sheet includes curving rails, repeated sleepers, rough rock faces, and timber mine supports.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Pushing Colt Behind Cover to Escape Spike's Cactus Grenade in No Time to Explain Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly pushing Colt behind cover to escape Spike's cactus grenade in No Time to Explain, with Spike visible beyond the barricades. The spiked grenade arcs overhead while Colt crouches with two pistols. Shelly's hands on his shoulder, cross-braced crates, and scattered debris create distinct areas across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Fighting Beside Colt and Poco in the Final Street Battle from No Time to Explain Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly fights beside Colt and Poco in the No Time to Explain street battle in this printable coloring page, bracing her shotgun in the foreground. Colt raises his pistols behind her, while Poco holds a skull-headed guitar beneath his broad sombrero. Crates, a barrel, building fronts, and an outlined explosion frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Bringing a Brawl Coin to Reboot 8-bit in Last Stand Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly bringing a Brawl Coin to reboot 8-Bit in Last Stand, holding the large star-marked coin toward the seated arcade robot. Crossed-out eyes and a downturned mouth fill 8-Bit's screen. The coloring sheet pairs the robot's controls and coin slot with Shelly's simple outfit and a sparse desert background.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Springing From the Bushes to Ambush El Primo in Showdown Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly springs from the bushes to ambush El Primo in Showdown in this printable coloring page, extending her shotgun while leaves scatter around her raised knee. El Primo turns toward her with wide eyes and an open mouth. Dense bush outlines, a skull-emblem belt buckle, cacti, and a nearby crate add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Taking Cover Behind a Barrel as Dynamike's Dynamite Lands Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly taking cover behind a barrel as Dynamike's dynamite lands nearby, crouching with her shotgun held close and her head turned. Dynamike stands on a raised ledge wearing a miner's lamp. The coloring sheet includes bound dynamite sticks, a curved throwing trail, impact marks, and broad barrel staves.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Confronting Mortis and His Swarm of Bats Among the Graveyard Tombstones Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly confronts Mortis and his swarm of bats among graveyard tombstones in this printable coloring page, aiming upward as Mortis leaps forward with his shovel. His top hat, pointed collar, and cape contrast with Shelly's bandanna and boots. Cracked headstones, iron fence spikes, bare branches, and a cratered moon fill the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Escaping Spike's Spreading Field of Cactus Spikes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly escaping Spike's spreading field of cactus spikes, running between tall pointed thorns with her shotgun held upright beside her head. Spike stands behind her with both arms raised. Repeated triangular spikes and curling dust surround Shelly's forward step, while broad rock walls and a barrel complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Running in Team Battle Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly runs through a team battle arena in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a skull-badge headband while carrying her shotgun low in one hand. Her zipped jacket, rolled sleeves, and ponytail create clear character sections. Flags, bunting, stone walls, crates, and curved ground borders add varied shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Pointing in Tropical Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly pointing across a tropical island shore, with a star hair accessory, a neck bandanna, and her shotgun behind her shoulder. A curved palm tree rises from the opposite side of the beach. The coloring sheet leaves broad areas of sand, sea, clothing, and sky between the simple shoreline outlines.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Posing in Mine Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly poses at a mine entrance in this printable coloring page, holding her shotgun diagonally upward while standing between heavy timber supports and scattered ground rocks. A hanging lantern and pickaxe sit beside the tracks behind her. The coloring sheet contrasts broad trouser and ponytail sections with belt pouches, railway sleepers, and wood-grain details.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Posing in Arcade Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Shelly posing in an arcade zone, holding an angular gun across her waist between game cabinets with joysticks and button panels. Her star-patterned bandanna and patched trousers add small costume details. Outlined arcade signs, a shelf of toy prizes, and square floor tiles complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Looking Around in Space Station Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly looks around a space station in this printable coloring page, holding her shotgun across her waist beside a wide window overlooking stars, planets, and a satellite. Screens and button panels line the curved interior walls. A circular doorway, floor grates, exposed cables, and a warning-marked crate create smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Standing in Robot Factory Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly standing in a robot factory, holding her shotgun beside a tall humanoid robot with exposed wires and chest gears. Her star-patterned bandanna echoes the star in her hair. Tools hang over a workbench, while large pipes, nuts, bolts, and a wall gear add mechanical details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Exploring in Rocky Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly explores a rocky canyon in this printable coloring page, walking along a winding ledge with her shotgun raised beside her head and a bandanna around her neck. Layered cliffs extend into the distance, framing her smaller figure. The coloring sheet includes scattered stones, a cactus, bushes, and broad rock bands divided by curved contours.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Jumping in Desert Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Shelly jumping through a desert canyon, with both boots off the ground, one arm extended behind her, and her shotgun forward. A large star decorates the back of her jacket. Broad cliff ledges, tall cacti, loose rocks, and small plants provide open, clearly separated shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Shelly Walking in Arcade Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: Shelly walks through an arcade zone in this printable coloring page, resting her shotgun across one shoulder while passing game cabinets with joysticks and button controls. Large stars decorate the floor and the arch above a nearby doorway. Hanging star ornaments and simple wall symbols add smaller enclosed shapes around her figure on the coloring sheet.
